idea-plugin.name: ZplFlow - ZPL Live Preview & Label Tools
idea-plugin.description:
The complete developer tooling suite for Zebra Programming Language (ZPL) in JetBrains IDEs, powered by ZplFlow.

✨ Features

  • Embedded Language Server (LSP 3.17): Autocompletion, hover documentation, and parameter breakdown for 188+ Zebra commands.
  • Real-time Parameter Hints: In-depth parameter breakdown (types, defaults, valid ranges) directly in your editor.
  • Pixel-Perfect Live Preview: Interactive JCEF live preview of thermal labels side-by-side with your code (0 token cost).
  • Multi-DPI Resolution Switching: Switch dynamically between 152, 203, 300, and 600 DPI printhead profiles.
  • SHA-256 LRU Cache: Instant undo/redo with zero redundant server round-trips.
  • Code Formatting & Auto-indent: Reformat ZPL commands into clean, indented blocks with Ctrl + Alt + L.
  • Offline & Multi-platform: Zero external dependencies; bundled cross-platform binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

🚀 Quick Start

  1. Open any .zpl, .prn, or .label file.
  2. Open the ZplFlow Preview Tool Window on the right sidebar.
  3. Edit your ZPL code to see real-time preview updates and LSP parameter suggestions.
